title: Episode 3
summary: A wellness business owner dies from an apparent allergy.
method: The killer injected the victim earlier with snake venom (I guess the numbing cream means she didn't feel it). Then later, when the victim was going into shock, the killer put peanuts on her mouth so it would look like she died from a peanut allergy.
motive: The killer was about to be fired.
killer: One of the workers at the wellness company
notes: I know it's the first episode where Sebastian joins the team but the atmosphere on the team is very different than earlier seasons. Darlene seems to spend all of her scenes either being frustrated at Sebastian or being mad at Mervin for being rude.
